gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel.summary: TableLayoutPanel is a retained grid solver with bounded rows/columns, fixed/add-row/add-column growth, absolute/percent/auto tracks, explicit or automatic placement, row/column spans, cell borders, overflow inspection, and content-driven sizing.
remarks: Owns bounded row and column tracks with absolute, auto-size, and weighted percent sizing; placement is explicit or deterministic row-major automatic; spans and fixed/add-rows/add-columns growth are supported.
Exposes cell and position lookup, resolved track inspection, overflow reporting, optional cell borders, and `AutoSize`. Hidden children release their occupied cells.
gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel.ownership: Created by the application as a `Control::Ptr` (`std::shared_ptr<Control>`). A parent holds its children strongly and a child holds its parent weakly; cycles, duplicate stable IDs, cross-window reparenting, and disposed children are rejected. Disposal through `Component::dispose()` is synchronous and idempotent and revokes owned subscriptions before subclass teardown.
gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel.threading: UI-thread affine. Read and mutate on the owning Window's UI thread; wrong-thread mutation is rejected by the Window access guards (`Window::check_access` and `Window::verify_access`). The type is not internally synchronized.
gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel.availability: Renderer-neutral core (`gui_forms_controls`). Available wherever the GUI.Forms core builds: the macOS AppKit host, the Windows Win32 host, and the opt-in Linux X11 host. The public API is not yet stable.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::TableLayout.summary: Constructs a one-by-one table that may add rows during automatic placement.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::column_coun.summary: Returns the authored base column count.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::set_column_.summary: Validates the bounded nonzero count, resizes style storage, reconciles placement, and invalidates layout.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::row_count|s.summary: Returns the authored base row count.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::set_row_cou.summary: Validates the bounded nonzero count, resizes style storage, reconciles placement, and invalidates layout.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::grow_style|.summary: Returns fixed-size, add-rows, or add-columns automatic placement policy.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::set_grow_st.summary: Validates growth vocabulary and invalidates the table solution.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::auto_size|b.summary: Returns whether desired size follows the resolved grid extent.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::set_auto_si.summary: Commits content-driven sizing and invalidates table measurement/arrangement.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::cell_border.summary: Returns none, single, inset, or outset cell-frame policy.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::set_cell_bo.summary: Validates the closed border vocabulary and invalidates painting and semantics.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::column_styl.summary: Returns a read-only span over current authored column track policies.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::row_styles|.summary: Returns a read-only span over current authored row track policies.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::set_column_.summary: Validates column index and finite nonnegative absolute/percent/auto track data before invalidating the solution.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::set_row_sty.summary: Validates row index and finite nonnegative absolute/percent/auto track data before invalidating the solution.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::set_cell_po.summary: Requires a direct child, validates explicit row/column coordinates, and records stable placement metadata.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::clear_cell_.summary: Removes explicit placement so the direct child returns to deterministic automatic allocation.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::cell_positi.summary: Returns the explicit authored cell, not the transient automatically resolved cell.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::set_column_.summary: Requires a direct child and records a bounded positive column span.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::column_span.summary: Returns the retained column span or one when no metadata exists.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::set_row_spa.summary: Requires a direct child and records a bounded positive row span.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::row_span|st.summary: Returns the retained row span or one when no metadata exists.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::control_fro.summary: Returns the live control whose resolved cell/span covers the requested coordinate.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::column_widt.summary: Returns the most recently resolved logical track widths for inspection.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::row_heights.summary: Returns the most recently resolved logical track heights for inspection.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::layout_over.summary: Reports that fixed growth policy could not place every child without mutating the authored table shape.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::measure|Siz.summary: Resolves placement and track demands without assignment and returns content extent when auto-sized.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::arrange|voi.summary: Solves tracks against final bounds, commits resolved cells/track extents, and assigns span-aware margin-reduced child rectangles.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::on_paint|vo.summary: Paints the inherited container surface and records resolved cell borders with the selected frame policy.

gui_forms::TableLayoutPanel::semantic_de.summary: Projects a named table as a group and reports overflow state without inventing a platform-native grid identity.
